lead: Wisconsin plumbing deals with deep cold, basements, hard water and lead service lines. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers from Milwaukee to Madison.
risk: lead service lines, flooded basements and frozen pipes
risk_short: lead lines, flooded basements and frozen pipes
why: Milwaukee has many lead service lines, and the city is replacing them over time. Older homes also have galvanized supply lines and cast-iron drains. Water is hard in much of the state.
Winters freeze pipes, and spring thaws fill sump pits and basements. The Wisconsin Department of Safety and Professional Services licenses plumbers.
tips: Ask your utility about your service line.
Test your sump pump before spring thaw.
Keep your softener supplied with salt.
areas: Calls come from Milwaukee, Madison, Green Bay, Kenosha, Racine, Appleton, Eau Claire and rural Wisconsin.

faq.q: Does Milwaukee have lead water lines?
faq.a: Many older Milwaukee homes do. The city is replacing lead service lines over time, and you can check your address with Milwaukee Water Works. A plumber can also look at the pipe where it enters your basement.
